name: Picumnus

source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: One HAB southwest of a central paired-tower utility platform, twin round AGRI shells and STO to the northwest, a large stepped AGRI complex to the east, and individual green agricultural modules arranged in two groups.

buildings.label: AGRI
buildings.notes: Northern round AGRI shell including its attached western service wing. Curved wall is approximated by straight segments; attached roof tank is a separate detail. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

buildings.label: AGRI
buildings.notes: Southern round AGRI shell, western service wing and southern airlock vestibule. The open paved apron beyond the vestibule is not building footprint. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

Unlabelled roofed rectangular link between the two circular AGRI shells; separated into its own geometry part to keep each outline simple. It is physically attached to both shells. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

buildings.label: STO
buildings.notes: Rotated rectilinear STO building with separate roof wings. Right-angle corners are preserved in its local orientation; pixel rounding is approximate. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: Single HAB-labelled building with eastern entry wing. Terminal caret is retained as a map annotation and does not establish an extra floor. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

buildings.label: PWR
buildings.notes: PWR-labelled stepped utility building; rooftop circular regulator assembly traced separately. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

buildings.label: AGRI
buildings.notes: Large stepped AGRI complex with a north-south wing, central roof bridge and southern service wing. Major right-angle footprint corners kept within 24 points; roof tanks are separate details. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

Unlabelled gate/utility unit immediately north of the southern pad. Outdoor terminal is associated with this unit. Arch opening is not a continuous solid wall. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

Unlabelled fixed equipment/utility unit beside the west edge of the northern pad. Exact enclosure versus equipment platform is uncertain. Heights and floors are LOW estimates from exterior massing in the side view; interiors/storeys are unconfirmed.

notes: All coordinates are original 1644x925 Icons/Satellite pixels, x right, y down; source images share framing. Top menu and bottom legend are excluded.
Orange website i at top-left is excluded as requested; three blue settlement tips are retained and associated with nearest related buildings at low confidence.
All point.floor fields are null. Door access records only numeric glyphs actually printed; L0 terminal types preserve access-class meaning without inventing a numeric glyph on the icon.
Every detail object contains only id, kind and outline. Its optional interpretation/confidence is recorded in detail_notes/detail_confidence keyed by id.
Agricultural modules are 23 separate body/roof outlines (14 northwest,9 southeast); cast shadows and gaps are excluded.

Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: Pad objects contain only id,outline,centre,rotation_deg; no size or scale inferred. Ships, vehicles, people, rocks and shadows omitted.
Open path discontinuities are intentional where paving is unclear, where an arch interrupts the path, or where a map marker is offset from a real doorway.
Clockwise image-y-down outlines do not repeat the initial vertex; rounded walls use faceted approximation while genuine rectilinear roof corners remain square in local orientation.

pad_notes.pad-north: Original tracing note; pad-class statements are superseded by the verified size field, while visible-geometry observations remain applicable: Boundary follows visible pad/fence and painted bracket envelope. Northern edge is clipped by menu, making first-edge rotation 0 degrees the artificial closure direction. No pad size inferred.
pad_notes.pad-south: Original tracing note; pad-class statements are superseded by the verified size field, while visible-geometry observations remain applicable: Boundary follows the visible painted bracket envelope, excluding the ship. First-edge angle is clockwise from image +x, modulo 180. No pad size inferred.

A stepped AGRI roof mass stands east of the central yard, with green modules in two separated fields.
A large pad is beyond the eastern AGRI mass (north locally); the small pad is by the HAB side (south locally).

previous_scale.how: Weighted symmetric semantic roof-boundary ICP with independently matched pad target anchors; no physical pad dimensions or renderer rectangle constants used.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

previous_calibration.fit_method: Weighted symmetric semantic roof-boundary ICP with independently matched pad target anchors; no physical pad dimensions or renderer rectangle constants used.

pad_baselines.notes: Independent of pad edge dimensions. Approximate image target positions and camera foreshortening still limit accuracy.

validation_notes: Original local pixel geometry remains unchanged.
Pad targets hidden by a ship or clipped image have reduced evidential precision; recorded image centres are not geodetic surveys.
Roof paths are manually recorded template geometry and local envelopes are simplified; outline residuals measure registration quality, not source metric survey accuracy.
The affine model is diagnostic: a single uniform m_per_px cannot fully remove perspective/terrain distortion.
Artificial menu/legend/image-edge closing segments are excluded from roof samples; projected template points outside the visible map are excluded from registration.

Visible review finds systematic 30–60 px template-roof offsets in several modules even while the independent pad-centre baseline agrees with the scalar. Treat this as layout-scale evidence, not a precisely registered floor plan.
previous_calibration.uncertainty_interval_basis: Conservative visual/template registration allowance; not a statistical confidence interval. Includes approximate roof envelopes, occlusion, possible camera foreshortening and semantic template accuracy.

geometry_m.coordinate_precision_note: Four decimals support reproducible drawing and do not imply millimetre physical accuracy.
geometry_m.height_policy: Original height_m and floor estimates are retained; horizontal calibration does not establish heights.

pads.centre_basis: Visible fragment centre, not a surveyed full-pad centre

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
